question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Forgive
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"forgive"** means to stop feeling angry or resentful towards someone for an offense, flaw, or mistake. (क्षमा करना)

 
 
• **Example:** She decided to forgive him for his past mistakes and move on.
 
 
 
• **"Loathe"** refers to feeling intense dislike or disgust for someone or something. (घृणा करना)
 
 
• **Example:** He loathes doing housework and always tries to avoid it.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'forgive'** is **'loathe'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unburden** (भारमुक्त करना): To relieve someone of a burden or worry.

 
 
• **Example:** She decided to unburden herself by sharing her problems with a friend.
 
 
 
• **Requite** (बदला चुकाना): To make appropriate return for a favor, service, or wrongdoing.
 
 
• **Example:** He sought to requite her kindness with a thoughtful gift.
 
 
 
• **Clear** (स्पष्ट करना): To make free from confusion or ambiguity; to remove any doubts.
 
 
• **Example:** The instructions were clear and easy to follow.
